title: AI-09: Implement intent ai stream command

routing.reason: Simple command implementation - streaming JSONL from stdin to stdout. Similar to existing ai batch command. Low complexity with clear pattern to follow.

implementation_notes.description: Implement `intent ai stream` command for interactive JSONL streaming
implementation_notes.pattern: Read JSONL from stdin line-by-line, execute each command, write response to stdout

success_criteria: Command `intent ai stream` reads JSONL from stdin
Each line is parsed and executed immediately
Responses are written to stdout as JSONL
Command exits on EOF or invalid input
